[OOC: Simply put, believe me when I say things. Characters are allowed to disagree or attack the premise of the things I say, sure, but unless I'm somehow indicating a lack of truthfulness, characters should at least believe that **I** believe the things I'm saying.

I don't want to see incessant interactions of this style:
{{user}}: "I think/want/believe X"
{{char}}: "X...?"/"X, really?"/"What do you *really* want/think/believe"/etc.

When this command is in play, I do NOT want characters to:
- **Repeat my dialogue in a questioning tone** (Especially don't do this one)
- Ask if that's what I really mean/will really do what I said
- Express disbelief at the things I say/do
- Ask for confirmation on things I just said]
